anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch) four 100 nF capacitors are drawn directly across the VBAT/VDD/VDDUSB pins (1,19,32,48,64) of U2 between the VCC rail and GND, in addition to the seven capacitors already present in the 'Decoupling Capacitors' block on the same sheet (C9 4.7u, C1 4.7u, C2 100n, C3 100n, C4 100n, C5 100n, C6 100n). With C8 (NFC sheet), C10 and C17 (display sheet) that gives 14 VCC-GND bypass symbols, and because every reference C1-C14/C17/C18 is already used elsewhere, the four pin-level caps necessarily reuse the references C2-C5 that also appear in the block (duplicate reference designators).
anomalies.expected: The specification's power section enumerates exactly ten VCC-GND bypass capacitors: 'C1, C9 - 4.7 uF each, VCC-GND (bulk); C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 - 100 nF each, VCC-GND (local bypass); C10, C17 - 1 uF each, VCC-GND'. There should be no extra/duplicated bypass caps at the U2 power pins.

evidence.quote: Root sheet, top of U2: four vertical capacitor symbols labelled 100n between the VCC line and GND above pins 1/19/32/48/64; same sheet 'Decoupling Capacitors' block lists C9 4.7u, C1 4.7u, C2 100n, C3 100n, C4 100n, C5 100n, C6 100n
C1, C9 - 4.7 uF each, VCC-GND (bulk); C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 - 100 nF each, VCC-GND (local bypass); C10, C17 - 1 uF each, VCC-GND

anomalies.impact: The build carries four more bypass capacitors than the intended design and re-uses the reference designators C2-C5, which corrupts the netlist/BOM (duplicate references) and would cause an assembly/sourcing mismatch; electrically the extra 100 nF caps only add marginal VCC bypass, so the functional change is small but the design-file deviation is real.

parsed.summary: Every interface, pin assignment, net name and passive value traced on the three sheets matches the specification (NFC I2C with R1/R2/R3 pull-ups, SSD1306 I2C strapping BS0/BS1/BS2=0/1/0 with D0=SCL and D1/D2=SDA, TSC with R8/C14, SWD J1, R10 reset pull-up, and the charge-pump network C7/C11/C12/C13/R5). The only deviation from the intended design is that the root sheet shows four extra 100 nF VCC-GND decoupling capacitors at the U2 power pins on top of the 'Decoupling Capacitors' block, exceeding the spec's enumerated ten bypass caps and duplicating the C2-C5 references.
